title: Edge kind: flow dir: down
ext: HTTP client | server.dataPlaneAddr @gray
[Edge] blue tls: TLS | when server.tls.enabled limits: Within limits? | rate, in flight, body route: Route or name? | a rule, or /function/<name> r4xx: Refused | 429, 503 or 413 @red [/]
[Backends] green right fn: Function | the invoke chain site: Site | files from its Bucket lake: Lake | its gateway [/]
r404: 404 Not Found | no route @red
ext > tls > limits limits > route: yes limits > r4xx: no route > Backends: yes route > r404: no
